document: R5-E RESULT — the compute-matched baseline (理 11364). THE FRONTIER MOVED.
the_question_R2_could_not_answer: R2 reported G at +34% compute and called it a premium. That compared TWO POINTS AT DIFFERENT COMPUTE and so said nothing about the frontier. R5-E gives the BASE G's whole budget, by raising its action budget, and asks what it buys.

COMPUTE_MATCH.note: the base is handed slightly MORE compute than G spends, so the comparison is if anything generous to the base.

THE_PRE_WRITTEN_READING_APPLIES: 理 11364: 'Q_base(≈9,170) below Q_G by more than the paired CI → the frontier moved.' Q_base is 9.3 points below Q_G and the CI [+3.7, +15.0] excludes zero. THE FRONTIER MOVED. G is not buying success with compute; at equal compute it wins.

AND_理S_EXPECTATION_WRITTEN_FIRST_HELD.predicted: from the 80-problem probe: more budget buys the base ~+3.7 points; the head buys +11-14 for ~+34% compute.
AND_理S_EXPECTATION_WRITTEN_FIRST_HELD.observed at 300: budget 12->16 bought the base +3.6 points (18.7 -> 22.3) for +35% compute; the head bought +13.0 points (18.7 -> 31.7) for +34%.
AND_理S_EXPECTATION_WRITTEN_FIRST_HELD.reading: the prediction was written before the run and the shape held almost exactly.

THE_BUDGET_WAS_CHOSEN_BY_A_RULE_FIXED_BE.rule: nearest to the target by measured tokens/episode on slice 1, absolute distance
THE_BUDGET_WAS_CHOSEN_BY_A_RULE_FIXED_BE.why_it_mattered: budget 18 had the BEST slice-1 success of the three (24.0%). A rule chosen after seeing the numbers would have been tempted toward it. Fixing the rule first is what makes this compute-matched rather than a search for the base's best showing.
THE_BUDGET_WAS_CHOSEN_BY_A_RULE_FIXED_BE.robustness: the 0.26% target difference does not change the selected budget (16) -- the choice is robust to it

MECHANISM_descriptive_no_test.reading: even with 35% more compute the base localises worse than G does. The extra budget buys more attempts, not better aim.

paired_stats_raw.pair: R5-E: base at budget 16 (compute-matched) vs G at budget 12
paired_stats_raw.method: paired per-problem bootstrap, 10000 resamples; exact two-sided binomial on the discordant pairs

bounds: One seed (v3 seed 21), one model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), 4-bit-free bf16. 300 problems per arm, paired per problem.
EACH BUDGET IS A DIFFERENT AGENT: the budget is in the prompt, so budget-16 is an agent told it has 16 actions -- NOT a budget-12 agent truncated or extended.
Slice 1 of the budget-16 arm is REUSED from the ladder: identical agent, identical tasks, temp 0. R2d's calibration measured uncached re-runs as 40/40 identical on this hardware.
The controller cost added to G is R2b's MEASURED 2,487.9 tokens/episode for the measured system (k separate full-prompt passes). A cheaper controller would only widen G's lead.
This is ONE point of a frontier, not a curve. It says the base at ~9,200 tokens does not reach G at ~9,200 tokens; it does not chart either arm's full quality-cost curve.
